game.blurb: The base game: settle an island, then change its rules.
game.name: Tutorial Island

look.tagline: Settle an island. Rewrite its rules. The constitution holds.

samples.text: (law "Seven penalty" (on-roll (for-each-player (and (= rolled 7) (< 7 (+ (holding each grain) (+ (holding each timber) (+ (holding each ore) (+ (holding each wool) (holding each brick))))))) (transfer each bank grain (/ (holding each grain) 2)) (transfer each bank timber (/ (holding each timber) 2)) (transfer each bank ore (/ (holding each ore) 2)) (transfer each bank wool (/ (holding each wool) 2)) (transfer each bank brick (/ (holding each brick) 2)))))
samples.title: Seven penalty

samples.text: (law "Poor relief" (on-round-end (for-each-player (<= (points each) 2) (transfer treasury each grain 1) (transfer treasury each wool 1))))
samples.title: Poor relief

samples.text: (law "City gift" (on-build city (for-each-player true (transfer each actor grain 1))))
samples.title: City gift
